notes: «جميعا» makes both routes meet at منصور: the text writes منصور and سالم once, so they form the shared tail.

«- قال ابن المثنى - عن أبي المليح»: Ibn al-Muthanna's version adds أبا المليح after سالم; Abu Dawud says Jarir does not name him. Not written as a link here (shared tail has no place for a one-route addition).
